extracted.intended_audience: cord-cutters and prospective Hulu + Live TV subscribers
extracted.subtask_description: A consumer-facing guide listing which channels and services are included with a Hulu + Live TV subscription, plus pricing, device setup steps, and notes on regional restrictions and features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unlimited DVR and setup/fees claim
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu + Live TV includes unlimited DVR recording and advertises a seamless setup without hidden fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exact phrasing on page: "With Hulu + Live TV, you get access to 95+ live and local channels, unlimited DVR recording, and a seamless setup without hidden fees — so you can start streaming your favorite networks in no time."

rubrics_metrics.name: Bundled access to Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN+ on-demand libraries
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu + Live TV subscriptions also come with full streaming access to Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+ Bundle Basic/Premium or Legacy on-demand libraries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page note: "Hulu + Live TV subscriptions also come with full streaming access to Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+ Bundle Basic/Premium or Legacy on-demand libraries." Also repeated: "*Live TV plan required to watch live content on Hulu. Regional restrictions, blackouts, and additional terms apply."

rubrics_metrics.name: Local channels availability & lookup
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu + Live TV offers local channels (including ABC, CBS, NBC, and the CW); availability varies by zip code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page guidance: "Enter your zip code to discover the local channels available in your area." Note reiterates regional restrictions/blackouts: "*Live TV plan required to watch live content on Hulu. Regional restrictions, blackouts, and additional terms apply."

rubrics_metrics.name: Live sports availability and channel examples
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu + Live TV supports streaming live sports via local networks and dedicated sports channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page example channels for sports: "From local networks like ABC, CBS, and FOX to dedicated sports channels like ESPN, MLB Network, and the Golf Channel — you can follow your favorite teams all season long." Also includes a sports guide link and the live TV plan requirement note.

rubrics_metrics.name: Live news availability and channel examples
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu + Live TV offers live national and local news channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page examples: "including CNN, ABC News, NBC, CBS, MS NOW, FOX, and NewsNation live to keep up with breaking news..." Includes same live TV plan / regional restrictions caveat.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pricing summary
rubrics_metrics.description: Base pricing: plans start at $89.99 per month for 100+ live channels and bundled access to Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN+ libraries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exact phrasing: "Hulu + Live TV plans start at $89.99 per month for 100+ live channels and access to the Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+ Bundle Basic/Premium or Legacy streaming libraries of TV shows, movies, documentaries, and more." Page includes a link to discover full plans and pricing.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to get and set up Hulu + Live TV (signup and device setup)
rubrics_metrics.description: Steps to start: sign up or log in, set up any Live TV–supported devices, then start streaming live and local channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page steps: "Sign up, or log in with your Hulu credentials if you’re already subscribed (current Hulu subscribers can switch to Hulu + Live TV from their Account page). Set up any Live TV-supported devices to start streaming, such as Android TV, Apple TV, Chromecast, Fire TV, LG TV, Mac and PC browsers, PlayStation®, Roku, Samsung TV, VIZIO, Xbox, and more. Start streaming live and local channels at home or on the go!"

rubrics_metrics.name: Supported devices (examples)
rubrics_metrics.description: Devices supported for Live TV streaming include a range of smart TVs, streaming devices, consoles, and browsers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Devices listed on page: Android TV, Apple TV, Chromecast, Fire TV, LG TV, Mac and PC browsers, PlayStation®, Roku, Samsung TV, VIZIO, Xbox, and more.
